public.text: The legacy assessment asks whether a system aligns with REDDHI and can expose APIs, but does not require evaluation of clinical safety, cybersecurity, accessibility, data quality, performance, or ongoing support.
public.suggestedRevision: Add these assessment dimensions and require a documented disposition decision for every significant legacy system.
